[[File:Oasis_mining_colony.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] arrived at the Oasis mining colony [[Oasis (moon)|moon]].]]
The '''Oasis mining colony''' was an [[oxite]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation on a [[Oasis (moon)|volcanic moon]] located in [[Maelstrom Nebula/Legends|the Maelstrom]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Rodin Higron]] led a band of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]&ndash;affiliated [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] out of the mining colony, and allowed the Alliance to use the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] as a [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]].

==Behind the scenes==
The unlicensed, and thus non-canon, roleplaying magazine article "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]" attributes the [[Oasis system]] to the ''[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|Riders of the Maelstrom]]'' adventure scenario, which was the first source to mention the [[Oasis mining colony]] moon,<ref name="ESBN">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref> and places the system in [[Relgim sector/Legends|Relgim sector]].<ref name="VSF13">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref>
